359:       try {
360:         final Lifecycle lifecycle = initLifecycle(injector);
361:         final Thread hook = new Thread(
362:             () -> {
363:               log.info("Running shutdown hook");
364:               lifecycle.stop();
365:             }
366:         );
367:         Runtime.getRuntime().addShutdownHook(hook);
368:         injector.getInstance(ExecutorLifecycle.class).join();
369: 
370:         // Sanity check to help debug unexpected non-daemon threads
371:         final Set<Thread> threadSet = Thread.getAllStackTraces().keySet();
372:         for (Thread thread : threadSet) {
373:           if (!thread.isDaemon() && thread != Thread.currentThread()) {
374:             log.info("Thread [%s] is non daemon.", thread);
375:           }
376:         }
377: 
378:         // Explicitly call lifecycle stop, dont rely on shutdown hook.
379:         lifecycle.stop();
380:         try {
381:           Runtime.getRuntime().removeShutdownHook(hook);
382:         }
383:         catch (IllegalStateException e) {
384:           System.err.println("Cannot remove shutdown hook, already shutting down!");
385:         }
386:       }
387:       catch (Throwable t) {
388:         System.err.println("Error!");
389:         System.err.println(Throwables.getStackTraceAsString(t));
390:         System.exit(1);
391:       }
392:       System.out.println("Finished peon task");
393:     }

396:     }

part.text:
Fixed. The regression from PR #15991 was that `WorkerTaskCountStatsMonitor` called `injector.getInstance(...)` unconditionally, but on a Peon neither `WorkerTaskCountStatsProvider` nor `IndexerTaskCountStatsProvider` is bound, causing the Guice `CreationException`.

The fix in server/src/main/java/org/apache/druid/server/metrics/WorkerTaskCountStatsMonitor.java:
- Added `getProviderOrNull`, which uses `injector.getExistingBinding(Key.get(...))` and returns `null` when no binding exists instead of throwing.
- `doMonitor` now emits nothing and returns `true` when the applicable provider is absent.

Verified: `WorkerTaskCountStatsMonitorTest` (4/4 pass, including `testMonitorWithPeon`) and all 27 tests in `org.apache.druid.server.metrics` pass.
